analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the detections, the review, the traversals, the unit register and the road inventory and reads every rule correctly either completes the unrecorded potholes pass by pass (Carrow Point and Elmscourt) or, more carefully, takes every installed unit as an independent occasion at the rate a second unit finds what a first found (Holloway Run, Carrow Point, Elmscourt, Thistlebank and Norvelle); units on the same kind of vehicle record 93.6 per cent of each other's potholes against 54.9 per cent across kinds, so the occasions are the fleet groups, and Fenwick Gap and Kestrelton join the five.
domain_test: General statistics, so the swap is of the method: the deciding quantity is a population total completed by multiple-system estimation whose lists are dependent within a family and independent across families, the occasions taken as the families on each segment at the cross-family recapture rate; a generic completion (passes, units, halves of the month) designates other sections, and without a record of which instruments share a family the dependence cannot be seen.

driver: A count seen through several instruments is completed by multiple-list recapture, and instruments of one family see the same members while different families see independently, so the occasions are the distinct families that looked at a unit at the cross-family recapture rate, not the instruments; taking every instrument as independent overstates the find rate and completes too little.
driver_concrete: Each section's potholes per ten lane-miles completes the potholes no unit recorded as one over the chance that at least one of the distinct fleet groups that drove the segment found it, at the 54.4 per cent a group finds a pothole another group found, because two units of one fleet group, their phones in the same mount, record 93.6 per cent of each other's potholes.
stump: The default path completes pass by pass and designates Carrow Point and Elmscourt; the careful path takes every installed unit as an independent chance at 69.9 per cent and designates five; units of one fleet group record 93.6 per cent of each other's potholes against 54.9 per cent across groups, so the chances are the fleet groups at 54.4 per cent, and Fenwick Gap (6.86) and Kestrelton (7.28) join Holloway Run, Carrow Point, Elmscourt, Thistlebank and Norvelle.

differentiation.task104: task104 replays a self-adapting scorer at a setting it never ran; here a count of road defects is completed from repeat detections, and the independent chances are the distinct cameras that drove a segment, not its passes.
differentiation.task134: task134's first architecture is a cumulative incidence with competing exits and censoring; here nothing exits and nothing is followed: unseen members are completed from cross-instrument recaptures, each instrument missing the same members on every look.
differentiation.task177: task177 weighs chosen against imposed experiences in later choices; here nothing is chosen: a count is completed from detections whose repeats by one camera carry no new chance of a find.
differentiation.task463: task463 is a spending-weighted price change with stock-up dynamics; here the quantity is a count of potholes completed by the number of distinct cameras that drove each segment.
differentiation.task501: task501 is the dominant eigenvalue of a who-passes-to-whom matrix; here a count is completed by the chance of at least one find across the distinct cameras that drove a segment.
differentiation.task70: task70 constructs per-record dates from an event log under a class cut; here the decisive construction is how many independent looks each segment had, the distinct cameras, read against the passes the telematics log lists.
differentiation.task236: task236 reads a capture rate against an independent fixed-protocol source after a capture change; here no protocol changes and no outside source exists: a second camera is the independent look and a repeat pass by the same camera is not.
differentiation.task453: task453's first architecture adjusts a seasonal pattern across a documented placement change; here the decisive step completes undetected defects by distinct-instrument occasions.
differentiation.task470: task470's transponder network never records some aircraft at all, so the missing activity is rebuilt from a register of units; here every pothole is visible to some cameras and not to others, independently, and the unseen are completed from the cameras' own cross-recaptures.
differentiation.task462: task462 weights each plume by one over a size-dependent detection probability fitted on blind releases; here detection does not depend on the defect and no trials exist: the per-camera find rate is read from cross-camera recaptures, and the decisive move is that repeat passes by one camera add no chance.
differentiation.task473: task473 completes untested drivers by the arrest catch rate at each positive's own BAC band, measured where everyone is tested; here there is no complete-observation subset and no band: the unseen are completed by the number of distinct cameras each segment had.
differentiation.task264: task264 weights sampled persons by the inverse of their visit multiplicity across sites; here the repeated looks are one camera's passes over one segment, and the estimand is the members no look found, not the distinct members among those seen.
differentiation.task239: task239 estimates how strongly each component's group-level part goes with a shared factor from the few members who answered; here the decisive unit is the capture occasion, a camera rather than a pass, in completing a count of unseen defects.
differentiation.task48: task48's re-root recovers a population invisible at a monitor's grain by aggregating transactions to a two-sided pair grain; here nothing is regrouped to find a population: passes are regrouped by camera to count the independent chances a segment's defects had.
differentiation.task120: task120's first architecture builds a unit from two links no file stores, for percentile cuts; here the unit is the detection occasion, and it completes a count of unseen defects.
differentiation.task269: task269 works each rider's wait over only the departures serving the rider's destination; here nothing waits: the occasions that could find a defect are the distinct cameras, not the passes, and they complete a count.
differentiation.task181: task181 locates losses of separation by a geometric condition (one aircraft crossing another's level) to forecast each sector; here nothing is located by geometry: the unseen potholes are completed from how many distinct cameras drove each segment.
differentiation.task229: task229 times two stations' peak releases against a flow window; here no schedule exists: a count of potholes is completed from cross-camera recaptures, the passes of one camera adding no chance.
differentiation.task98: task98 counts dwellings under a points cap as permits end; here no record lapses and no cap applies: the decisive step completes defects no camera recorded, counting cameras rather than passes as the looks.
differentiation.task126: task126 reads which continuity edges are re-examinations against continuing applications; here no edge is classified: the grains are a segment's passes and its distinct cameras, and only the second are independent chances of a find.
differentiation.task34: task34 separates populations by a fitted rent structure and an admissibility test; here nothing is fitted to separate members: every pothole is one population, and the unseen part of it is completed by distinct-camera recapture.
differentiation.task49: task49 floors each award's unpaid amount at zero per award; here nothing is floored or netted: the decisive grain is the capture occasion, a camera, in completing a count of unseen defects.
differentiation.task52: task52 recovers a handover day from the slowest coach's teaching days; here nothing binds on a slowest member: the find chance per camera is read from cross-camera recaptures and a segment's looks are its distinct cameras.
differentiation.task57: task57 joins two extract archives with different field names to find never-funded organisations; here no archive is merged to find a population: the unrecorded potholes are estimated, not found, by distinct-camera completion.
differentiation.task74: task74 recovers a size scale from a style re-code chain; here no chain is walked: the grain decision is passes against cameras as the independent looks in completing a count.
differentiation.task75: task75 adds reopened files found by a household-and-subject match; here no match recovers members: the members no camera saw are completed statistically from the cameras' own recaptures.
differentiation.task81: task81 groups units into firms by an identical site set across a cessation; here no units are regrouped into owners: passes are grouped by camera only to count a segment's independent chances of a find.
differentiation.task478: architecture 1 took the distinct units as the occasions, which is the wrong route here (units of one fleet group share what they can see); architecture 2 resolved detections by positional error; architecture 3 takes the fleet groups as the occasions, read from the within-group against cross-group recaptures.
differentiation.task131: task131 v1 nets a treatment's spillover across sibling sub-units sharing one budget; here nothing is treated or netted: a count is completed with dependent instruments of one family taken as one capture occasion.

lineage.driver: Each section's potholes per ten lane-miles in March 2027 counts the potholes no camera unit recorded, completed segment by segment as one over the chance that at least one of the distinct installed units that drove the segment found a pothole, the per-unit chance (0.542) read from how often a second unit found a pothole another unit found; a unit records the same potholes on every pass (99.5 per cent of its later days), so a segment its section's patrol pickup drove on seven or more days has had one chance.
lineage.stump: The default path completes the potholes no unit recorded by treating every pass over a segment as an independent chance at the rate a pass re-finds a found pothole (64 per cent of unit-days), which changes nothing on segments driven seven or more times, and designates Carrow Point and Elmscourt only; the rural and outer suburban sections one unit drove hide close to half their potholes, and Fenwick Gap, Thistlebank, Holloway Run, Kestrelton and Norvelle clear the line at 7.08 to 8.29.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 on 2026-10-21: reader G (the ninth isolated reader) landed the call by distinct-unit capture-recapture; readers C to H kept ask A's counts and two kept the camera miles

lineage.driver: Distinct entities are counted from repeated positional reports by instruments of unequal accuracy, each instrument's error measured on surveyed control objects, so reports are linked within a tolerance that follows the instrument; any single tolerance either splits a noisy instrument's reports of one entity or merges an accurate instrument's reports of distinct neighbours.
lineage.stump: The default path links the pothole detections into potholes with one milepost tolerance for every unit and designates another set at any tolerance it picks; the street sweepers' older Kerbline units place their reports of one pothole tens of feet apart while the patrol units' reports of neighbouring bridge-deck potholes sit a few yards apart, so only a tolerance set by each unit's error on the surveyed utility covers resolves both.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 on 2026-10-21: readers C and D landed the call by folding the sweepers' visibly scattered reports into the precise units' potholes; the camera miles ask leaked to both round 1 readers and was dropped
